title: Intent-conditioned and Non-toxic Counterspeech Generation using Multi-Task Instruction Tuning with RLAIF
findings: The proposed COARL framework significantly outperforms existing benchmarks and prominent LLMs like ChatGPT and GPT-4 in generating high-quality, intent-conditioned counterspeech. For hate speech targeting religious groups (e.g., Muslims), the model demonstrates a superior ability to identify and address underlying stereotypes like Islamophobia, producing more context-appropriate and effective responses.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures the ability of models to generate effective, non-toxic, and intent-conditioned counterspeech in response to hate speech targeting various groups, including religious groups. This includes dispelling stereotypes and biases, such as Islamophobia.
